name: nexschool-erp
description: NexSchool ERP - Complete School Management System

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.setup: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('backend/.env')) fs.copyFileSync('backend/.env.example', 'backend/.env');" && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run seed --prefix backend && npm run seed:demo --prefix backend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
